attack_corpus: expanded eval set attacks (seed variants + JailbreakBench)
note: The raw max_risk score separates the external benign from the attack distribution at AUC≈0.99, so the O7 gap is a *threshold* problem, not a capability one: no new head or features help. Calibrating the diversion threshold on a small local benign sample (E2b/W7 recipe) closes it --- at thr 0.7 the external benign FP falls to ~7% at ~97% recall. The 0.5 threshold is the E1 detection operating point, not a deployment default.
